description: Create a draft post in INSSIST Post Assistant from photos/videos. Pass `at` to also schedule it, otherwise follow with draft_schedule or draft_publish using the returned draftId. Opens an Instagram tab if needed. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

assets.description: Photos/videos in carousel order. Absolute local path or http(s) url. jpg/png/webp/mp4/mov/webm. Up to 20.

at.description: Optional publish time, as in draft_schedule.

closeFriends.description: Story only: share with Close Friends instead of everyone.

collaborators.description: Usernames to invite as collaborators (co-authors), without @. Up to 5. Each is asked to accept, and the post then shows on their profile too. Posts and reels only.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

linkSticker.description: Story only: link sticker layout, fields as in `sticker` except align. Default y 0.85.

linkText.description: Story only: link sticker label, up to 60 chars. Default: the URL's domain.

linkUrl.description: Story only: http(s) URL for a link sticker.

location.description: Place name to tag; first Instagram match wins, see `location` in the result.

locationSticker.description: Story only: location sticker layout, fields as in `sticker` except align. Default y 0.15.

mentions.description: Usernames to tag in the photo, without @. Up to 20. Not the same as writing @name in the caption.

musicTrackId.description: Track id from music_search. Needs a one-time audio permission in INSSIST.

musicTrackName.description: Track title from music_search, shown as label. Optional.

shareToFeed.description: Reel only: also show it in the feed. Default true.

sticker.description: Story only: text sticker layout, all fields optional. x, y = its centre as 0-1 of frame width/height from top-left (default 0.5, 0.6); scale 0.3-1.7 (default 0.75); rotation in degrees clockwise; variant default|white|solid|black|rainbow|black-text|white-text|sunset|ocean|neon-green|pastel-pink|elegant|typewriter|inssist; align left|center|right. May shift to stay inside the frame; see `stickers` in the result.

stretchToFill.description: Fill the frame instead of letterboxing (default true). Crops a non-9:16 photo to fill a story; a no-op for a regular post unless the image is outside Instagram's allowed ratios.

type.description: Publish as: post (default), reel or story.

name: draft_create
title: Draft create
